The '''Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster''', also known as the '''Blueleaf Temple''', was a [[temple]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] located on the [[Taurin Delta]], just downstream the [[Unnh River]] from the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]].

==Description==
Its name came from the fact that images of [[blueleaf]] shrub leaves were carved into the outer surface of the temple. The Blueleaf Temple was half as tall as the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] [[Great Temple/Legends|Temple]], but had a proportionately wider base.
The majority of the temple was taken up by a single vast opening, with stairs leading up and down to levels of alcoves carved into the walls. The temple contained a mysterious [[Color/Legends|blue]] energy crystal.

==History==
[[File:RMQ-TempleBlueleafCluster.jpg|thumb|left|180px|[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] troops explore the temple]]

When it was surveyed by [[Dr'uun Unnh/Legends|Dr'uun Unnh]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], several anomalies were detected; consequently, [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|General Jan Dodonna]] ordered the entrance be sealed with rocks. After the Rebels evacuated [[Great Temple/Legends|Yavin Base]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces burned through the rocks to gain access believing it to hold Rebel supply stockpiles. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and possibly well before, it was discovered that aggressive insectoids, designated the [[kliknik]]s, inhabited the temple's interior, effectively keeping any outsiders from entering.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

The temple was visited by [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], [[Kam Solusar]], and [[Brakiss]] in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], as part of a survey of the Massassi temples that Horn was carrying out to find which temple the spirit of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] was anchored in.<ref name="I,J">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> During the [[Assault on Yavin 4]] in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], Imperial forces believed it to be the Jedi headquarters, and it therefore sustained heavy [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] damage.<ref name="DS">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

[[File:Blueleaftempleinterior.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The mysterious blue energy crystal within the temple]]
